# Invocation Examples

## Full Repository Documentation

```text
Use Mermaid Documentation Skill v3.2 to inspect this repository and generate the smallest evidence-proven Mermaid diagram portfolio. Run diagram selection, proof-based claim validation, six-way parallel review, overlap analysis, pruning, revalidation, and audit update.
```

## Validate Existing Documentation

```text
Use Mermaid Documentation Skill v3.2 to validate the existing MermaidDiagram folder against the current codebase. Prove every node and edge, identify duplicated diagrams, and auto-fix or remove only findings with final confidence >=90% and direct source evidence.
```

## Focused Diagram Portfolio Review

```text
Run the v3.2 Diagram Portfolio Reviewer on the existing Mermaid documentation. Produce purpose records, pairwise overlap results, merge/remove recommendations, confidence scores, adjudication decisions, and audit updates.
```

## Evidence-Only Review

```text
Review the diagrams using direct code, configuration, test, and infrastructure evidence. Do not accept reviewer agreement as proof. Mark ambiguous claims for human review and remove unsupported diagram elements.
```
